run_densepose_coco_annotation_tests: run the unittest test suite to validate COCO dataset loaded annotations against expected instance counts
run_densepose_lvis_annotation_tests: run the unittest test suite to validate LVIS dataset loaded annotations against expected instance counts
test_load_coco_json: test loading COCO JSON annotations using load_coco_json with an annotations file path and image root
test_load_lvis_json: test loading LVIS JSON annotations using load_lvis_json with an annotations file path and image root
test_validate_densepose_annotation: test validating a DensePose annotation dict using DensePoseDataRelative.validate_annotation to check correctness
